approved.ruling_source: runs/g4/gate.json approved_design_proposals #1 (style.json H2-footmen-anatomy): 'Frog-Footman and Fish-Footman are upright livery figures with real frog / fish heads, photoreal CGI.'

anatomy_proposal.proposal: Option A (proposed): a real frog body, not a human frame. He sits upright on his haunches the way frogs rest, and can stand up on his long hind legs for the bow. Forelimbs keep four frog fingers with round toe tips; they are enough to hold the letter. He moves in short hops or a slow crouching crawl. The livery is tailored to the frog shape: short-bodied tail coat, breeches over the thighs, no shoes on the webbed hind feet. The head is pure frog, apart from the powdered curled wig the text gives him.
alternatives: Option B: a semi-upright frog that walks on two legs the whole time, with slightly longer forelimbs and a frog body inside a full-cut livery (closer to Tenniel, more humanised).
Option C: a frog of natural size with no livery at all; this conflicts with the text's 'in livery' and the pair's tangled-curls bow, so it is not recommended.
anatomy_proposal.pairing_constraint: He must match CHAR-fish-footman in height and stance, so their curls tangle when both bow (ch006-p03). Whatever option is chosen at H2 applies to both Footmen.

rendering.limits: Frog skin, eyes and mouth are photoreal; speech by the wide frog mouth and throat. No cartoon face, no human hands, no human in costume.

build.height_note: Standing height on his hind legs; sitting upright about 55-60 cm. Dream-scale frog (a real common frog is 6-9 cm); proportions stay frog.
build.body_type: squat, soft, pear-shaped, no neck, long folded hind legs
build.posture: sits heavily on the doorstep with knees splayed, head tipped back; bows by tipping his whole body forward
build.scale_reference: The Duchess's house is 'about four feet high' (ch006), so he is sized to its door. Alice arrives at nine inches (SUP-003): to her he is several times her height.
build.reason: The previous card's 165-170 cm human height is dropped. A dream size matched to the four-foot house is more faithful to the text.

marks.description: No permanent marks. A faint pink graze on the tip of the snout appears only after the plate beat (ch006-p10); it is a continuity state, not a base mark.
marks.reason: Source shows the plate 'just grazed his nose'.

default_outfit_tone: Faded snuff-brown Duchess-household footman's livery tail coat (FAC-duchess-household emblem_visual: plain, visibly poorer than the crimson Hearts livery of CHAR-fish-footman), worn thin at the cuffs, with plain tarnished brass buttons and no crest, badge or heraldic mark, over a plain buff wool waistcoat and cream knee-breeches; bare webbed hind feet (no stockings or shoes); slightly rumpled from sitting on the ground. Cut to the frog body per the H2 anatomy option.

default_outfit_tone_source.reason: Livery is sourced; colours designed. Coat colour and badge follow index.json factions = FAC-duchess-household (DEF-p3-appearance-303-a / DEF-p3-relationship-001-a). Stockings and buckled shoes are dropped because the feet are frog feet. The old magnifying spectacles (a human-performer device) are dropped: his own eyes now carry the look. BIB-0029 (DEF-p4-char-302): the waistcoat is plain buff wool, not mottled olive-and-moss-green satin — costumes.json COS-036 and the H2-locked sheet both show buff, and buff keeps the waistcoat from merging into the green frog skin; costumes.json stays the wardrobe authority for prompts.

badge.value: none: plain tarnished brass buttons, no crest, heart or household badge
badge.reason: bible/politics.json FAC-duchess-household.emblem_visual gives no heraldic marking.
